findings.issue: como que treats כַּאֲשֶׁר as the Spanish idiom of appearance or approximation (as if / sort of), which the preposition+relative does not license; the token is as / according to that which.

notes: Remaining tokens match: 3ms hizo with Moisés y Eleazar, el sacerdote, mandó (piel), Jehová, and את as personal a before Moisés.
